sentence: This project builds a model that simulates how meltwater on the surface of ice shelves makes them flex, fracture and break up.
This project builds graph network models that use physical knowledge to describe how water behaves in streams and freshwater ecosystems.
This project builds deep learning models that use physical principles to predict how fluids flow and move through the subsurface.
This project builds cell-like vesicles made only of proteins that can sense a signal at their surface and respond inside.
This project studies how bacterial tyrosine kinases are activated and regulated in Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
This project studies how evolutionary responses of a plant to more carbon dioxide and nitrogen change the flow of carbon in coastal marsh ecosystems.
This project studies how past efforts to control human reproduction shaped the way scientists and medical communities understand reproductive health.
This project uses algebra and statistics to study how AI systems work, so they can be made more reliable and transparent.
This project designs methods that let the nodes of a distributed system reach agreement when an adversary controls some, using little time and energy.
This project combines deep learning with process-based modeling to study how much nitrogen moves from land into rivers during drought and floods.
This project reconstructs how the fish community and food web of a desert river changed over 800 years, using fish skeletons and museum specimens.
This project builds graph learning methods that separate shared and distinct patterns in biological data, with brain connectomics and cancer biology as applications.
This project uses mathematics and machine learning to work out how gene regulatory networks behave, including in a deadly fungus.
This project tests whether a stem cell niche in a marine worm can make both somatic and germline cells.
This project builds a low-cost optical attachment that turns existing microscopes into systems that image cells in real time without labels.
This project extends a framework that combines neural networks with biophysical models to turn genomic data into predictions of how genes are regulated.
